events.title: ECMAScript 2015 (ES6) adopted
events.summary: Ecma approved ECMA-262 6th edition — classes, modules, arrow functions, promises, and let/const.
events.about: ES2015 modernized JavaScript for large apps — `import`/`export` modules, `class`, `async`/`await` foundations via promises, arrow functions, and block-scoped `let`/`const`. Enabled React/Vue-scale frontends and cleaner Node.js services without transpiler hacks for every feature.

narrative.whyChosen: ES2015 was the biggest JavaScript language update since 1999 and enabled modern frontend tooling.
narrative.whyImportant: It started TC39's annual release cadence and made JavaScript viable for large application codebases.
narrative.problemSolved: JavaScript lacked modules, lexical scoping, and class syntax that developers expected from other languages.
